propositions: A separately attested plan-review gate must run before task/story/epic close to prevent closure when plan or upstream pins changed during execution, without invalidating implementation file changes.
The gate must be configurable via require_plan_review_for_close flag, default false, and perform zero model/network calls using only local signature and validity checks.

CLOSE validity profile intentionally disables code freshness but enforces signature, reopen, registry, own material, phase compatibility, and pin enforcement to catch plan/phase/material drift between precheck and lock.

The gate runs inside the existing transaction lock via a generic pre_status_check callback in txn.transition_core, immediately before STATUS append, ensuring atomic rejection of concurrent plan/signature/phase/material changes.

Unsigned, reopened, stale-registry, own-material drift, phase incompatibility, or malformed metadata block close regardless of pin enforcement; pin drift/missing/malformed blocks only when enforce_plan_material_pins=true.
Existing exemptions (bugs, session logs, code reviews, identities, idea→closed) and non-empty force-close reason bypass the gate; structural child-closure rules are never bypassed.
